title: Oshkosh Corporation: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (302 affected)
summary: THE REAR AXLE BRAKE LINES CAN CRACK AND LEAK.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL (11,091 affected)
summary: THE BALL SOCKETS ON THE CRUISE CONTROL LINKAGE CAN BREAK, ALLOWING THE CRUISE CONTROL LINKAGE TO BECOME DETACHED ON ONE END AND JAM ON NEARBY COMPONENTS, WHICH COULD IMPAIR THROTTLE PLATE OPERATION.

title: R&R CUSTOM COACHWORKS,INC: EXHAUST SYSTEM:MUFFLER:RESONATOR (159 affected)
summary: THE HEAT SHIELD, BETWEEN THE MUFFLER AND THE PLYWOOD STORAGE COMPARTMENT, CONTAINS OVERSIZE HOLES WHICH ALLOW HEAT FROM A RUPTURED MUFFLER TO PENETRATE THROUGH TO THE PLYWOOD STORAGE COMPARTMENT.

title: WESTERN STAR TRUCKS, INC.: POWER TRAIN:CLUTCH ASSEMBLY:LEVEL:RELEASE:THROW:OU (10,893 affected)
summary: PREMATURE FAILURE OF THE ALUMINUM CLUTCH RELEASE LEVER CAN OCCUR FROM STRESS CORROSION DUE TO CONTINUOUS LOADING OF THE LEVER AND EXPOSURE TO ROAD SALT SPRAY.

title: Toyota Motor Corporation: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (3,655 affected)
summary: THE WRONG SAFETY BELT LATCH TONGUE PLATE WAS INSTALLED IN SOME SAFETY BELT ASSEMBLIES.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: EXHAUST SYSTEM (88 affected)
summary: THE A.I.R./ EXHAUST CHECK VALVES AT THE ENGINE MAY MALFUNCTION ALLOWING HOT EXHAUST GASES TO PASS INTO THE RUBBER HOSES WHICH NORMALLY CARRY UNHEATED AIR.

title: GENERAL TIRE & RUBBER CO.: TIRES (280 affected)
summary: THESE TIRES ARE MISLABELED: (1) EACH SIDE OF THE TIRE WAS BRANDED WITH DIFFERENT TIRE SIZE NUMBERS. (2) THE TIRE PRESSURE WAS BRANDED INCORRECTLY (140 PSI INSTEAD OF THE CORRECT 120 PSI) AND (3) THE LETTERS "DOT" WERE NOT BRANDED BEFORE THE SERIAL NUMBER OF THE TIRE AS REQUIRED BY THE FEDERAL TIRE STANDARD TO INDICATE THAT THE TIRE MEETS THE MINIMUM FEDERAL STANDARDS.

title: STEWART & STEVENSON SERV.: STEERING:GEAR BOX (28 affected)
summary: THE ROLL PIN USED TO ATTACH THE U-JOINT TO THE STEERING SHAFT CAN "BACK OUT" OF ITS POSITION AND SHEAR.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): FUEL:FUEL SYSTEMS (3,000 affected)
summary: FUEL TANK FLANGES WERE NOT BENT AS REQUIRED TO ALLOW THE SPECIFIED CLEARANCE FOR THE FUEL TANK MOUNTING STRAPS AND FUEL LINES AT THE TANK.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (280,000 affected)
summary: ON 1987 THROUGH EARLY 1990 MODELS, BOTH FRONT BRAKE HOSES CAN WEAR DUE TO DIRECT CONTACT WITH THE WHEEL OPENING SPLASH SHIELDS. ON THE LATE 1990 THROUGH 1992 MODELS, PERIODIC RUBBING CONTACT OF THE LEFT FRONT BRAKE HOSE CAN OCCUR DUE TO MOVEMENT OF THE SPLASH SHIELD IN CERTAIN VEHICLE OPERATING CONDITIONS.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC (108,836 affected)
summary: FRONT FUEL FEED HOSE ASSEMBLY COULD CRACK OR SEPARATE AT THE COUPLING ON THE ENGINE END OF THE HOSE ASSEMBLY, ALLOWING FUEL TO LEAK INTO THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (4,385 affected)
summary: SAFETY BELT RETRACTOR LOCKS UP WITH THE BELT IN THE STOWED POSITION.

title: WESTERN PRODUCTS: FUEL:LPG LINES:FITTINGS SYSTEMS (112 affected)
summary: THE LPG PIGTAIL HOSE WHICH CONNECTS TO LPG BOTTLE AND LEADS TO THE LPG REGULATOR CAN SEPARATE AT THE CRIMP THAT CONNECTS THE BRASS PETROLEUM, OIL, AND LUBRICANTS (P.O.L.) NUT TO THE FLEXIBLE GAS HOSE.

title: NATIONAL COACH ENGINEERIN: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM WHEEL CYLINDERS (167 affected)
summary: THE INCREASED WEIGHT OF THE STRETCH CONVERSION LIMOUSINES REQUIRES LARGER DIAMETER REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDERS THAN THOSE INSTALLED IN THE FACTORY.

title: General Motors, LLC: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC (43,413 affected)
summary: THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION SHIFT CONTROL CABLE CAN SEPARATE.

title: International Motors, LLC: STEERING:POWER:SHAFT PITMAN (145,682 affected)
summary: THE SAGINAW GEAR DOES NOT RELIEVE PRESSURE WHEN THE WHEELS HAVE BEEN TURNED FULLY AGAINST THE AXLE STOPS. THE RESULTING CONTINUED PRESSURE ON THE STEERING SYSTEM CAN RESULT IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF CRACKS IN THE SPLINES OF THE PITMAN SHAFT, WHICH CAN DEVELOP INTO A COMPLETE FRACTURE OF THE PITMAN SHAFT.
